source: Captures of real cubes from smartcube-web-bluetooth (https://github.com/poliva/smartcube-web-bluetooth, captures/), MIT License, Copyright (c) Pau Oliva, Copyright (c) Andy Fedotov. Kept here: the traffic of each capture as [op (n notify, r read, w write), characteristic (its 3rd to 8th hex digits), data], and the turns, last state and first battery level its decoder saw. In every capture the cube starts solved and is turned R U R' U' then a T permutation, twice, back to solved.
